ops.note: PR #11 (merged 198b290). hostregistry.SSHError.Exited reports true only for a status exit (*daemonkit.ExitError with Signal 0). consent.ProbeRoutesAround routes around only on a timeout or an Exited() SSHError, so a refused spawn (EBADF past OPEN_MAX) or a local signal death is now fatal and carries its cause instead of reading as offline. The relay leg stays fail-closed on every ssh failure, 255 included; only a timeout advances (note ba072f61). No retry, fallback, or bypass was added; trust and binding checks are unchanged. Regression tests: TestExecSSHPastOpenMaxNeverRunsSSH, TestSSHErrorExitedShapes, TestSSHErrorExitedFromARealRunner, TestRouteProbeLocalFailureIsFatal, TestRouteRelaySSHFailureIsFatal, TestDecideRouteSpawnFailureIsFatal.
